summary: Completed comprehensive testing of A Sign astrology dating app. Backend APIs are functional with proper authentication protection. Frontend displays correctly with responsive design and proper branding. Authentication flow works correctly with Google OAuth integration.

minor_issues.impact: Cosmetic console error, but expected behavior
